description: Status of a submission by ticket: waiting for confirmation, in review, published, rejected, answered by email, waiting for payment, expired. Once the sender has confirmed by email, it also shows the sender's balance (free releases left, paid releases left); when payment is due, the package prices (net and with VAT) and the same payment links as the offer email; after publication, the evidence (URL, date, publication, labelling, link attribute, social posts). Read only, moves no money.
name: estado_nota
title: Status of a submission
